name: supervise-run
description: Launch, watch, auto-heal and report a Runpod training run.

run_id.description: The id of the run to supervise (ow-<run>).

steps.prompt: A supervision poll reported new activity for run {{run_id}}. Read the watch result, the run status and the triage-run skill, then take the smallest safe action that keeps the run healthy. Never raise a budget, delete a volume or terminate a kept Pod. Ask before any destructive action when you are unsure.

Run {{run_id}} has reached a terminal state. Write a concise post-mortem: what happened, which detectors fired, what actions were taken, and the final spend. Use the overwatch tools to gather status and metrics.
